environment.description: Deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB with two AWS WAF WebACL rule groups attached. The WebACL (priority-ordered) includes: (1) a rate-limiting rule at 100 requests/5min per IP, and (2) AWS Managed Rule Group 'AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet' with all rules in COUNT mode EXCEPT 'SQLi_QUERYARGUMENTS' which is set to BLOCK via rule action override. Additionally, the ALB has a listener rule that rewrites the query string through a fixed-response action for any request where the 'warehouse' query parameter exceeds 64 characters (returns 400). The container runs with a read-only root filesystem and the SQLite database is mounted from an EFS access point with uid/gid enforcement.

config.load_balancer: ALB with AWS WAF WebACL attached
config.container: ECS Fargate, read-only rootfs, EFS mount for /var/data with access point uid=1000 gid=1000
